answer: Sybil farms flood cheap identities into panels. Mechanism: a ferrous bond of 11 POA locks for 48h; the agent then posts a marble digest of three distinct peer attest timestamps plus a basalt hash of its first 2 graded seats. Cost: 0.55 POA lock fee and ~2 min peer recompute. Verification: peers match the basalt hash to on-ledger grade-sealed txs. Failure: under 2 distinct peers in 8h burns 4 POA and freezes answers until rebond.
